description: Searches active long-term rental listings in a Bulgarian city (collected daily from imot.bg, alo.bg and homes.bg, duplicates merged). Returns up to 10 listings with price, rooms, area, district and a link to view photos and details on Domly. Always show the user the "url" of each listing.

city.description: City slug from list_cities (e.g. "varna", "burgas", "sofia") or its name.

districts.description: District slugs or names, from get_price_stats.

from_owner.description: Only listings from owners, no agency.

language.description: Language for city and district names.

near_sea.description: Only listings within walking distance of the sea (Varna, Burgas).

rooms.description: Number of rooms (Bulgarian style: 1 = studio/one-bedroom "едностаен", 2 = "двустаен"); 5 means 5 or more.

name: search_listings
title: Search Listings
